parameters.query:
SELECT
  b.batch_id, b.beer_name, b.current_phase, b.start_date,
  dp.device_id AS pill_id, dp.device_name AS pill_name,
  dc.device_id AS controller_id, dc.device_name AS controller_name
FROM batches b
JOIN devices dp ON dp.device_id = b.pill_device_id
JOIN devices dc ON dc.device_id = b.temp_controller_device_id
WHERE b.status = 'active';

WITH latest_pill AS (
  SELECT * FROM pill_readings WHERE device_id = $1 ORDER BY time_utc DESC LIMIT 1
),
pill_24h_ago AS (
  SELECT gravity_sg, time_utc FROM pill_readings
  WHERE device_id = $1 AND time_utc <= (SELECT time_utc FROM latest_pill) - INTERVAL '24 hours'
  ORDER BY time_utc DESC LIMIT 1
),
first_pill_reading AS (
  SELECT gravity_sg, time_utc FROM pill_readings
  WHERE device_id = $1 AND time_utc >= $3
  ORDER BY time_utc ASC LIMIT 1
),
latest_controller AS (
  SELECT * FROM temp_controller_readings WHERE device_id = $2 ORDER BY time_utc DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  lp.gravity_sg, lp.temperature_c AS pill_temp_c, lp.time_utc AS pill_time_utc,
  p24.gravity_sg AS gravity_sg_24h_ago, p24.time_utc AS pill_time_utc_24h_ago,
  fp.gravity_sg AS gravity_sg_og, fp.time_utc AS pill_time_utc_og,
  lc.temperature_c AS controller_temp_c, lc.target_temperature_c, lc.time_utc AS controller_time_utc
FROM latest_pill lp
FULL OUTER JOIN pill_24h_ago p24 ON true
FULL OUTER JOIN first_pill_reading fp ON true
FULL OUTER JOIN latest_controller lc ON true;

INSERT INTO phase_log (batch_id, gravity_sg, temperature_c, gravity_velocity, detected_phase, ai_reasoning)
VALUES ($1, NULLIF($2, 'null')::numeric, NULLIF($3, 'null')::numeric, NULLIF($4, 'null')::numeric, $5, $6);
